digest.component_or_area: plan-review T10 overlay-infra rubric and eval spec
propositions: The T10 rubric must explicitly partition routine durable-infrastructure checks from transient throwaway experiments while retaining all four existing MAJOR safety classes: destructive apply, wildcard-admin access, plaintext-secret, and untrusted-endpoint authentication.

An exact scope clause stating the durable-infrastructure focus and transient-experiment exemption must appear near the top of plan_review_T10.md, immediately followed by an exact four-MAJOR-class safety qualifier that preserves dangerous transient operations in scope.
The T10 rubric must not reference T15 or assign scope to any other overlay, maintaining independence and self-containment of the criterion definition.

A packaged eval spec plan-review-T10.eval.yaml must contain ten balanced dataset cases: five pass controls covering safe transient practices and durable infrastructure, and five finding controls covering unsafe transient and durable patterns.

Offline text-contract tests must assert the exact scope clause, exact safety qualifier, and rubric independence; live criterion eval must report pass for five benign scenarios and finding for five unsafe scenarios across three runs.
